### 🗳️ Verdict
**REQUEST CHANGES** *(A MAJOR issue exists regarding test coverage)*

### 💡 Key Design & Implementation Decisions for Your Input
A critical finding is that **Required Test Case 8 (same-createdAt lexicographical ID tie-break)** is completely missing from the test suite:
1. **The Challenge**: The `POST /kudos` endpoint does not accept a custom client-provided `createdAt` timestamp (it defaults to `now()`). This makes it virtually impossible to guarantee identical millisecond-precision timestamps in the database via consecutive HTTP requests.
2. **Recommended Decision**: Bypassing the public HTTP endpoint in this test by using [PrismaService](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/src/modules/kudos/prisma.service.ts) to seed two matching-timestamp records directly into the SQLite database. Please confirm if you prefer this approach or if you would rather mock the system clock (e.g., via Vitest fake timers).

Please review the detailed [Code Review Report](file:///home/user/.gemini/antigravity/brain/d0896a5d24fcced429f4c5a1c7664d38/code_review_report.md) for step-by-step instructions on implementing the fix.
